pages.text: The $(d)Spectre Sword$() is comparable to a Diamond Sword, with higher durability and enchantability.$(br2)It increases your entity interaction range by 3 blocks, and can be used to kill $(l:irregular_implements:items/ectoplasm)Spirits$(/l).

The $(d)Spectre Pickaxe$(), $(d)Spectre Axe$(), and $(d)Spectre Shovel$() are comparable to their Diamond counterparts, with higher durability and enchantability.$(br2)They increase your block interaction range by 3 blocks.
